# Reconstructed, not a verbatim capture of the whole run.
# Measured 2026-09-06: a real bundle recording foreign_archs ["i386"] was
# mounted into debian:12-slim and installed on a target that had NOT run
# `dpkg --add-architecture i386`. apt-get exited 100 and dpkg refused every
# archive with the line quoted verbatim below:
#   package architecture (i386) does not match system (amd64)
# The same bundle, same image, after one `dpkg --add-architecture i386`,
# exited 0. `apt-get -s install` succeeded in BOTH cases, which is why no
# simulate-based check can see this failure.
# The surrounding lines are apt-get install's standard shape for a dpkg
# unpack failure. Kept as a golden so failureDetail is exercised against the
# real ordering: the banner first, the explanation on an INDENTED
# continuation line, the useless summary last.
